name: Band V-Up
steps: Lie on your back with your legs extended, the band around your arches and an end in each hand overhead.
Press your lower back toward the floor and brace your abs tightly.
Simultaneously curl your torso up and lift both straight legs toward the ceiling while reaching the band forward toward your shins.
Lower your legs and torso slowly back down together as your arms return overhead under tension.
tips: Keep your lower back controlled on the descent; soften your knees slightly if it begins to arch.
Drive the lift with your abs rather than yanking the band with your shoulders.
